headline: Shoreline Stabilization Project presentation and design criteria, plus an agreement with Peaks Island Tax and Energy Assistance.
summary: Public Works will present on the shoreline project. The agenda also includes a resolution on ETIPP and an order approving a memorandum of understanding.
items: Public comment on public works issues (3 minutes per speaker)
Presentation from Department of Public Works on the Shoreline Stabilization Project
Resolution specifying design criteria for the Shoreline Stabilization Project
Order approving memorandum of understanding with Peaks Island Tax and Energy Assistance
General public comment (3 minutes per speaker)
Announcement that Community Fund Program applications are open
location: In person at the Peaks Community Center, and online at meet.google.com/zdh-xdto-tpg
